text:
tom (Hiring Manager): New hire Maya starts Mon. Need a one-paragraph welcome + 1-week bullet agenda and a tiny 30/60/90 I can paste. Also a one-line who-to-ping.
laura (People Ops): Sure  short pasteable below.
laura (People Ops): Welcome blurb: Welcome to Redwood! Your first week will focus on accounts, a product primer, meeting the team, and a small starter task to get hands-on. We'll deliver your laptop and accounts before your first day and assign a buddy for pairing. Expect a Day 1 manager 1:1 and an end-of-week check-in.
laura (People Ops): First-week bullets: Day 0: confirm device + paperwork; Day 1: People Ops intro 9:30, manager 1:1 11:00, buddy lunch 13:00; Day 2: product + repo tour; Day 3: starter ticket assigned, pair session; Day 4: docs + security intro; Day 5: EOW demo + 30m feedback. EOW deliverable: open small PR + 3-line learnings.
laura (People Ops): 30/60/90 (paste): 30d ship starter PR + finish security training; 60d own small feature from triage to merge; 90d lead minor improvement & reduce PR cycle time.
max (IT): Device queued to SF desk. CLI reprovision: rwctl provision --user maya.s --groups eng,repo-read --device mac-air. ETA imaging Mon 07:30 PT.
cesar (Security): Note: enable 2FA before infra creds. Ill run a 10-min security primer Tue 15:00. KMS access needs ticket + manager approval.
onboard-bot: New-hire packet created for maya.s. Tasks: I-9, payroll, SSO. Due: 2026-04-15 17:00 PT.
tom (Hiring Manager): Great  thanks all. One-liner who to ping: IT (@max) for device/accounts; Security (@cesar) for creds/2FA; People Ops (@laura) for payroll/benefits; Buddy for day-to-day questions.
